title: Traveller
suits: messaging, sending, delivery, routing, handoff products (a paper plane, a parcel, a tag): one object carries the story from slide to slide and lands on the thing that matters.

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: on each section: paper = --brand (pushed toward --ink-auto if it would vanish on the field), folds shaded toward --field, accent = --brand-2
params.Pack.traveller.spot(id, { x, y, rot, sca: where it rests on each slide; ground = the surface its shadow falls on
params.Pack.traveller.object({ preset, svg, kin: preset 'plane' (fly), 'parcel' (hop), 'ball' (roll), or your own svg using the --cy-tr-* colour vars

details: a tiny anticipation before every flight: it pulls back and noses up for a tenth of a second
it banks along the path (its angle follows the curve, a slight squash mid-flight)
when the next spot is behind it, it turns round with a quick flip as it pulls back
it overshoots its spot along the way it came in and settles with a damped wobble
a dotted trail follows the path and fades from the tail, gone by 1.2 s
a paper plane climbs a little and glides down: descending flights arc less
loop: true gives one loop-the-loop on the way to the happy moment
its shadow follows on the ground below, shrinking and fading with height, catching up a beat late
put ground on a card's top edge and the shadow falls onto the card
a fresh load throws it in from off the lower left
at rest it hovers on the one clock, nose bobbing gently, the hover easing in after landing so nothing jumps
print shows it at every slide's spot, facing the way it came
the plane is folded paper: a far wing peeking above, a shaded keel, a highlight, a crease, all derived from the brand colour
the parcel leans into each hop, squashes on landing and kicks up dust; the ball rolls by the distance travelled
